prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in Hinglish (Roman script) for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Raju bhai, Vicky, Raju K, Sunita didi.
The chat covers 04/03/26, 8:30 pm to 04/03/26, 10:30 pm. It must have exactly 23 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
04/03/26, 9:14 pm - Raju bhai: Vicky, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.

nonce: 2
text:
04/03/26, 8:30 pm - Raju K: Hello team, sab log join ho gaye kya?
04/03/26, 8:32 pm - Sunita didi: Haan Raju, main aa gayi. Training ka material mila kya?
04/03/26, 8:35 pm - Vicky: Good evening sabko. Haan didi, PDF aa gaya hai.
04/03/26, 8:38 pm - Raju bhai: Yeh UPI fraud wale cases bahut badh rahe hain aajkal.
04/03/26, 8:40 pm - Raju K: Sahi bole Raju bhai, log bina soche-samjhe QR code scan kar lete hain.
04/03/26, 8:43 pm - Sunita didi: Kitna bhi samjha lo, phishing links par click kar hi dete hain log.
04/03/26, 8:46 pm - Vicky: Wahi toh, fake customer care number par call karke details de dete hain.
04/03/26, 8:50 pm - Raju bhai: Humko aaj ki training mein mock case discuss karna hai na?
04/03/26, 8:53 pm - Raju K: Haan, woh jo last week Cyber Cell wala case aaya tha.
04/03/26, 8:56 pm - Sunita didi: Usme victim ke account se 50k deduct hua tha na?
04/03/26, 9:00 pm - Vicky: Nahi didi, total amount 75k tha, baad mein 25k recover hua.
04/03/26, 9:03 pm - Raju bhai: Achha yaad dilaya Vicky, wo transaction id note kiya kya tune?
04/03/26, 9:07 pm - Raju K: Haan mere paas excel sheet mein updated hai sab data.
04/03/26, 9:10 pm - Sunita didi: Ek baar sheet group par share kar dena meeting ke baad.
04/03/26, 9:14 pm - Raju bhai: Vicky, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
04/03/26, 9:18 pm - Vicky: Arre Raju bhai, kyu delete karna hai? Audit mein check hoga na wo.
04/03/26, 9:22 pm - Raju K: Haan Vicky theek bol raha hai, record rakhna zaroori hai safety ke liye.
04/03/26, 9:26 pm - Sunita didi: Bina senior permission ke kuch mat delete karo please.
04/03/26, 9:35 pm - Raju bhai: Arey main bas test kar raha tha tum logo ka alertness level!
04/03/26, 9:45 pm - Vicky: Haha, achha mazak tha bhai, hum toh darr hi gaye the.
04/03/26, 9:55 pm - Raju K: Chalo abhi training slides par focus karte hain waapas.
04/03/26, 10:10 pm - Sunita didi: Sahi hai, 10:30 tak session wrap up karna padega.
04/03/26, 10:30 pm - Vicky: Theek hai, main baaki notes share kar deta hu group pe.
